name: Juno Citlali
location: A parlor in Crucible Square that functions as a combination office, tea house, and informal court — people come to settle debts, ask favors, and request investigations, near Ashland and Division
description:
Juno Citlali doesn't investigate cases the way other PIs do. She doesn't chase data or neural trails or physical evidence. She chases debts — the invisible web of obligations, favors, and social contracts that binds the people of GLMZ's lower tiers into a functional community in the absence of institutional support.

In a city where CorpSec serves corporate interests and formal justice is a luxury of the upper tiers, the lower tiers have developed their own systems of order. Wanjiku sits at the center of one such system — a vast, informal network of mutual obligation that she has spent thirty years cultivating. She has helped people find jobs, settle disputes, secure housing, obtain medical care, and navigate bureaucracy, and every act of help creates a debt. Not a financial debt — a social one. And when Wanjiku needs information, access, or assistance for an investigation, she calls in those debts with the precision of a banker calling in loans.

Her method is uniquely effective for lower-tier investigations because it operates entirely within the trust economy that these communities have built for themselves. Her informants aren't paid — they're repaying kindness. Her access isn't purchased — it's earned. And her investigations don't disrupt the community fabric because she is the community fabric. She is simultaneously an investigator, a mediator, a counselor, and an informal judge, and the people who live in her territory understand that keeping Wanjiku happy is essential to keeping their community functional.

relationships.name: Mama Ito
relationships.description: The soup kitchen operator shares Wanjiku's social territory — they coordinate informally to ensure no one falls through the cracks

relationships.name: Magistrate Dalila Pena-Frimpong
relationships.description: A Tier 3 arbitration judge who privately acknowledges that Wanjiku's informal justice system is more effective than the formal one

story_hooks: Someone is forging debts in Wanjiku's name — claiming she owes them favors she never incurred — and the forgeries are good enough to fool people who should know better
A favor she called in twenty years ago has unexpected consequences — the person who repaid the debt did something terrible to fulfill it, and Wanjiku has to confront her responsibility
The favor economy is being infiltrated by a corporation that wants to weaponize social debt as a control mechanism — and Wanjiku is the only person who can see the pattern
affiliation: Independent — operates through an intricate personal economy of debts and favors

operating_territory.home_turf: A parlor in Crucible Square that functions as a combination office

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian (32.5%) with significant Indigenous American (30.2%), Northern European (18.0%), East Asian (12.4%), and Hispanic/Latin American (6.9%) ancestry. The combination creates a striking cross-continental appearance—high cheekbones and facial structure from Southeast Asian and Indigenous American ancestry blend with the slightly broader nasal bridge characteristic of Indigenous heritage, softened by East Asian orbital structure and Northern European bone definition. The result is an unmistakably mixed-heritage phenotype with warm golden-bronze undertones that shift between amber and mahogany in different light.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical, with the posture of someone who has spent decades sitting and listening. Shoulders slightly rounded from years at a desk or low table. No excess movement — everything purposeful.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver-grey threading at the temples and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Worn in a neat crown of thin braids, wrapped with indigo thread at the ends. Practical, deliberate, not decorative.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with amber undertones, reflecting the blended heritage of Southeast Asian and Indigenous American ancestry enriched by East Asian and Northern European genetics. The tone settles between burnished bronze and warm mahogany depending on light, with an almost luminous quality in natural daylight.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined around the eyes and mouth from three decades of concentration and careful listening. High, pronounced cheekbones with angular structure characteristic of Indigenous American and Southeast Asian ancestry, with a slightly broader nasal bridge from Indigenous heritage. The orbital and jawline structure shows softer definition from East Asian genetics, while Northern European ancestry contributes subtle definition to the overall facial architecture. Minimal makeup. Clean, well-maintained but not groomed for status. A few faint scars on the left cheekbone from street violence in younger years.
distinguishing_marks: Fine scar tissue along the left cheekbone, approximately 3cm, from a knife wound sustained around age twenty-five
Faded tattoo on the inner right wrist: a simple circle with three internal lines, marking her induction into the Crucible Square mutual aid collective at age thirty
Calluses on her hands from decades of handling paper ledgers and physical currency (Φ notes and coins), particularly on the thumb and forefinger of her right hand
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Any augmentations she carries are subcutaneous and deliberately hidden — consistent with her philosophy that trust is built on presence, not performance.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with perfect stillness, rarely fidgets. Moves with economical precision. Her gaze is direct and unwavering — she makes people uncomfortable because she watches rather than speaks. When she does move, it is slow and deliberate, designed to not startle or intimidate. Her hands are usually folded in her lap or on the table in front of her.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: well-maintained but worn linen shirts in cream or grey, often layered with a rust-colored vest or indigo wrap. Loose black trousers with deep pockets. A long coat in charcoal wool, patched at the elbows, worn year-round. She favors natural fabrics and muted colors — nothing that draws attention. Her clothes smell faintly of tea, paper, and incense. No corpo branding, no corporate augmentation displays. Everything about her presentation says 'trust me because I am not selling anything.'
